Hadith Collection (All in one) is an Ultimate Collection of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The app contains 41000+ hadith from 14 Most Accepted and Authentic Hadith books.

The 14 books included are:

1) Sahih al Bukhari صحيح البخاري - Hadith collected by Imam Bukhari (d. 256 A.H., 870 C.E.)
2) Sahih Muslim صحيح مسلم - Hadith collected by Muslim b. al-Hajjaj (d. 261 A.H., 875 C.E.)
3) Sunan an-Nasa'i سنن النسائي - Hadith collected by al-Nasa'i (d. 303 A.H., 915 C.E.)
4) Sunan Abu-Dawood سنن أبي داود - Hadith collected by Abu Dawood (d. 275 A.H., 888 C.E.)
5) Jami' at-Tirmidhi جامع الترمذي - Hadith collected by al-Tirmidhi (d. 279 A.H, 892 C.E)
6) Sunan Ibn-Majah سنن ابن ماجه - Hadith collected by Ibn Majah (d. 273 A.H., 887 C.E.)
7) Muwatta Malik موطأ مالك - Hadith compiled and edited by the Imam, Malik ibn Anas
8) Musnad Ahmad - Hadith compiled by Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal
9) Riyad us Saliheen رياض الصالحين
10) Shama'il Muhammadiyah الشمائل المحمدية
11) Al Adab Al Mufrad الأدب المفرد - Hadith collected by Imam Bukhari (d. 256 A.H., 870 C.E.)
12) Bulugh al-Maram بلوغ المرام
13) 40 Hadith Nawawi الأربعون النووية - Hadith collected by Abu Zakaria Mohiuddin Yahya ibn Sharaf al-Nawawi (631–676 A.H)
14) 40 Hadith Qudsi الحديث القدسي

Features:

● 41000+ Ahadith from the Sunnah
● Hadith grade (Sahih, Hasan, Daif etc.)
● Powerful Search
● Narration Chain and Compare Isnad
● List of Similar Hadith
● Share option
● No Ads
● Start reading from where you left off (last read)

Reference and Courtesy of Sunnah.com

If you find any errors/issues in the hadiths, kindly report it to us.

May Allah have mercy on the collectors and translators of the Hadeeth!

Share and Recommend this Beautiful Hadith app to your friends and family. May Allah bless us in this world and hereafter.

● The Hadiths included in the App are in Arabic & English Language ONLY. Although we would love to add more languages, we don't have the required hadith databases for other languages.

● We also feel compelled to make an observation here: this is not a fiqh or fatwa application. Hadith are made available on this application as a resource for research, personal study, and understanding. The text of one or a few hadith alone are not taken as rulings by themselves; scholars have a sophisticated process using the principles of fiqh to come up with rulings. We do not advocate do-it-yourself fiqh using these hadith for those who are untrained in these principles. If you have a question on a specific ruling, please ask your local scholar.
